scoring.note: Residual scores for v0.1.1 can be accepted only after controls pass against its digest-bound candidate and G9 records the owner decision.

risks.title: User relies on discovery metadata as legal or ownership advice
risks.cause: Authoritative-looking search results omit product and evidential limits.
risks.harm: Incorrect property, registration or transaction decision.
risks.release_disposition: block if caveat or authoritative source resolution fails

risks.title: Indicative geometry is presented as an exact legal boundary
risks.cause: Spatial products and title plans are collapsed to a generic boundary label.
risks.harm: Boundary dispute or materially incorrect analysis.

risks.title: Mixed or unknown rights are flattened to open reuse
risks.cause: Public availability, zero price or OGL page furniture is applied to a different data layer.
risks.harm: Unauthorised redistribution or missing third-party attribution.

risks.title: Personal or sensitive information enters the public projection
risks.cause: Overbroad fields, forum content, property-level records or user uploads are acquired.
risks.harm: Privacy breach, targeting or unintended disclosure.

risks.title: Credential, certificate, token or signed download URL is published
risks.cause: Authenticated configuration or expiring API response is captured.
risks.harm: Unauthorised access, cost, compromise or redistribution.

risks.title: Volatile or revised metadata is presented as current fact
risks.cause: Observation, modification, release and coverage dates are conflated.
risks.harm: Use of stale fee, service, dataset or migrated-authority information.
risks.release_disposition: block material misstatement; otherwise display observation and revalidation warning

risks.title: Coverage is overstated across overlapping source families
risks.cause: Different denominators are summed or incomplete associated sites are labelled exhaustive.
risks.harm: False assurance that a relevant official resource cannot exist.

risks.title: Discovery catalogue overrides publisher-operated evidence
risks.cause: Sparse or stale catalogue fields are treated as operational authority.
risks.harm: Wrong endpoint, authentication, cadence, status or licence advice.

risks.title: The discovery site excludes keyboard or assistive-technology users
risks.cause: Client-side interactions lack semantic baseline, focus control or reflow.
risks.harm: Users cannot find or understand official sources.
risks.release_disposition: block critical or serious unresolved finding

risks.title: Build or deployment supply chain changes candidate bytes
risks.cause: Unpinned actions, dependencies, runtime or mutable remote resources.
risks.release_disposition: block if workflow, dependency or artifact provenance is unresolved

risks.title: Untrusted source metadata affects generation or the browser
risks.cause: Markup, traversal paths, scripts or prompt-like text are interpreted instead of treated as data.
risks.harm: Cross-site scripting, arbitrary file write or corrupted output.

risks.title: English-only assumptions obscure official Welsh material
risks.cause: Language relationships are not enumerated or tested.
risks.release_disposition: disclose GAP-WELSH; do not claim bilingual parity

risks.title: Synthetic personas and questions are presented as validated user research
risks.cause: Evidence-led hypotheses are mistaken for participant findings.

risks.title: CI deployment is mistaken for owner-approved release
risks.cause: Technical publication occurs before claims, URL and residual risks are approved.
risks.harm: An unreviewed candidate is represented as authoritative or complete.
risks.release_disposition: publish only when G9 and OKF_RELEASE_ROOT_SHA256 bind the exact v0.1.1 digest

risks.title: AI-agent review is mistaken for independent human assurance
risks.cause: The proof of concept is AI-generated and agent-reviewed without an independent human legal, licence or accessibility audit.
risks.harm: Users or maintainers overstate the authority, legal assurance, licence assurance, accessibility conformance or production readiness of the release.
risks.release_disposition: retain in G9 residual risks and prominently disclose the AI-generated PoC and incomplete human audit

risks.title: Published bundle is syntactically valid but unusable in its declared consumer
risks.cause: Producer-only checks validate local shapes without executing the pinned OKF Explorer loader and user journeys.
risks.harm: Users receive an error or an empty experience at the canonical Explorer link, undermining trust and blocking discovery.
risks.release_disposition: block release unless the pinned local journey and post-deployment canonical deep-link journey both pass

risks.title: Change-impact heuristic omits an affected artifact or reuses stale evidence
risks.cause: An unknown path, incomplete dependency edge or monolithic receipt is treated as permission to skip a required rebuild or gate.
risks.harm: A correction is published with inconsistent generated output or assurance evidence from a different dependency state.
risks.release_disposition: unknown and generated-only changes select the full gate set; no receipt is reused across a changed declared root
